focus: security: hub install/doctor mutation surfaces, the mutation-class guard, and the pre-commit comment-hygiene gate

findingDetails.title: Chrome DevTools installer verifies its pinned CLI by version only, with no content digest, unlike the Bladebro installer
findingDetails.scopeProof: Chrome and Bladebro installers plus the mutation-class manifest row are all listed in review-scope-files.txt

claimAdjudication.claim: The Chrome DevTools installer verifies its pinned CLI by version only, with no content digest, unlike the Bladebro installer in the same hub.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched the Chrome script for a digest constant or verify function (none), read the install guide for a digest promise (version pin only), and read the manifest row that claims digest check for Bladebro alone.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: npm forbids republishing an existing version, so substitution needs a registry compromise or registry override; a pinned operator-invoked install may be judged sufficient.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Stays P2 while the only attack is registry compromise; would become P1 if the packet claimed digest verification for the Chrome CLI or allowed a configurable registry.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 against two accumulated P2 findings: weighted new 1 over weighted total 2, no refinement of a prior finding.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Security surface spans three installers, three doctors, a shared guard and a repo hook inside a 522-file pre-bound scope.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Only these surfaces in the packet execute commands or write outside a review-only process.
omittedHighRiskTargets: mcp-chrome-devtools/scripts/_utils.sh full body (helpers read around the destructive calls only)

searchLedger.claim: Pinned CLI install without a content digest cannot detect a substituted tarball while a sibling installer can.

searchActions.queryOrPath: chrome and bladebro install.sh pin/verify blocks
searchActions.result: chrome pins a version and installs; bladebro pins a version, installs with --ignore-scripts, verifies four SHA-256 values, removes on mismatch

searchLedger.rationale: Same hub answers the same supply-chain question at two different bars.

searchLedger.invariant: A tracked MCP registration carries no literal credential; secrets arrive through variable indirection.

searchActions.queryOrPath: api-key, bearer-token and provider-prefix patterns over the hub tree and the UTCP config
searchActions.result: no literal credential; the Figma entry uses a dotenv indirection resolved from the repo dotenv file

searchLedger.rationale: All browser manuals are stdio with empty env.

searchLedger.invariant: No installer executes a privileged command; a privileged suggestion stays a printed note.

searchActions.queryOrPath: privileged-invocation prefix across the three installers and three doctors
searchActions.result: one occurrence, inside a log_info suggestion string; no privileged execution

searchLedger.rationale: Privilege escalation stays with the operator.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two read-only doctors that spawn their MCP server contradict the guard's read-only contract.

searchActions.queryOrPath: guard header, manifest rows, packet catalogs for the doctor probes
searchActions.result: the probe is documented as READ-ONLY in two packet catalogs and is watchdog-bounded; the guard forbids unbounded network and mutation, not a bounded stdio handshake

searchLedger.rationale: The label matches the packet's documented classification.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Bounded stdio handshake is inside the class's allowed set.

searchLedger.invariant: The blocking gates verify staged content and fail closed when their checker is missing.

searchActions.result: comment hygiene reads staged blobs from a temp mirror; the mutation gate fails closed on a missing guard and triggers on the discovered path pattern

searchLedger.rationale: Both gates check committed content, not the working tree.
